rooms.title: [The Stone Eye, Top of the Eye]

description: This is the center of the ship, where the Krolvin load their cargo and move on and off the ship via the gangplank.  To the north, towards the stern, you can see the massive base of the mainmast.  Further aft is the quarterdeck.  Forward from here are the foremast trunk and the forecastle.
title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Amidships]
11090.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This skiff is small and appears not to have seen recent use.  There are some nicks and scratches in here, perhaps from someone hiding in here long ago.
title: [In The Skiff]
11091.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The massive mainmast of the ship towers high above your head here.  High up the mast, near the top, is a small crow's nest.  Ratlines lead up from both sides of the ship to provide access to the crow's nest for the lookouts.  Forward from here, to the south, are the gangplank and cargo hatch.  Stairs lead up to the quarterdeck at the aft end.
title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Aft]
11092.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This is a small wooden basket suspended high above the deck on the mainmast.  Lookouts here have a commanding view of the surrounding seas, but even the slight motion of the ship riding at anchor is enough to make you feel ill at this tremendous height.
title: [Krol Ship, Crow's Nest]
11093.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This is the command center of the ship, where the captain typically stands while the ship is at sea.  In the center of this deck is the ship's wheel from which the helmsmen steer the ship.  Some steps lead up to the poop deck, and another flight of stairs leads down to the main deck.
title: [Krol Ship, Quarterdeck]
11094.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This is the smallest and highest of the ship's decks and is surrounded on three sides by a sturdy wooden rail.  The mizzenmast trunk is located roughly in the center of this deck, and although it is the smallest of the vessel's three masts, it still rises to a dizzying height.
title: [Krol Ship, Poop Deck]
11095.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The companionway provides access to the lower decks of the ship here, while the corridor leads to the officers' quarters and the wardroom aft.  A small chartroom is off the companionway on the east side, and the companionway continues down.
title: [Krol Ship, Companionway]
11096.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This small room is almost filled with the massive chart table located in its center.  Numerous charts and maps cover the table, and navigational instruments are stored in lockers on either side of the room.
title: [Krol Ship, Chart Room]
11097.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This corridor extends fore and aft here, connecting the officers' quarters and the wardroom to the quarterdeck.
title: [Krol Ship, Corridor]
11098.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This cabin is shared by the middle ranking Krolvin officers, and can be distinguished from the junior officers' cabin only in that the room has two beds.  Of course, this leaves little room for anything else, so the room is otherwise empty.
title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
11099.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This small cabin serves as sleeping quarters for the most junior of the Krolvin officers.  The room is remarkably cramped and spartan as it is filled almost entirely by a large bunk bed.
title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
11100.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This corridor extends fore and aft.  An ornate archway leads into the large wardroom aft of here, while the corridor continues forward to the south.
title: [Krol Ship, Corridor]
11101.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This is the cabin of the first officer of the Krolvin ship.  Despite the importance of this position, the ship's design affords him little luxury.  A small desk and a bed are the only items of furniture here, while the walls are adorned with nothing but an empty ornamental sheath, which is firmly attached to the bulkhead.
title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
11102.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This cabin is shared by the second and third officers of the ship, and is slightly larger than that of their underlings.  Two beds and a desk are all the furniture that could fit in this cabin.
title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
11103.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This room extends across the entire beam of the ship here at the stern, making it one of the biggest on board.  Delicate windows once looked out over the transom, but have now been boarded up by the practical Krolvin.  A large dining table, with seats for a dozen or so, is still set with plundered porcelain, crystal, and the remnants of the Krolvins' meal.
title: [Krol Ship, Wardroom]
11104.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You find yourself precariously balanced atop a stack of several large casks, but well within reach of the cargo grate above you.
title: [Krol Ship, Hold, Casks]
11105.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hold is a bit brighter here due to the moonlight filtering in through the cargo grate high above.  Several large casks are stacked beneath the grate.
The hold is a bit brighter here due to the sunlight filtering in through the cargo grate high above.  Several large casks are stacked beneath the grate.
title: [Krol Ship, Hold Amidships]
11106.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hold extends the length of the ship, from the aft companionway all the way to the bow.  The air here is damp and stuffy, and the meager light filtering down from the decks above is barely enough to see by.  Large crates and barrels are piled all around, as far into the semi-darkness as you can see.  The companionway leads up from here to the upper decks and down into the bilge.
title: [Krol Ship, Hold Aft]
11107.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: It is so dark in this room that you can barely discern shapes in the gloom.  Through the shadows you can make out the form of a skeleton of some sort hanging from the shackles on the wall.  The whole place has a distinct air of death and decay.
title: [Krol Ship, Brig]
11108.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This hallway connects to the Purser's office and the arms locker off to the south.  An elegantly crafted set of double doors is the entrance to the captain's quarters.  Even the area outside the cabin is neat and tidy, with not a splotch of dirt to be seen.
title: [Krol Ship, Companionway]
11109.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This cabin extends from the companionway aft to the stern, and across the entire width of the ship.  Compared to the squalor of the crew's and officers' quarters, the elegance of this cavernous room is unbelievable.  Plush carpets cover the floor, and tapestries hang on the walls.  Gold trim shines brightly on the ornate woodwork, and comfortable furniture invites the visitor to relax.
title: [Krol Ship, Captain's Cabin]
11110.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This hallway connects the Purser's office and the arms locker to the companionway aft.  This area appears to have been the scene of some recent violence.  The arms locker door hangs uselessly off its hinges, little more than a splintered plank, and the steel door to the Purser's cabin appears to have been forced open by repeated blows with a large hammer.
title: [Krol Ship, Passageway]
11111.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The Purser's Office, once the orderly financial center of the ship, appears to have been recently ransacked.  The strongboxes and files have been strewn about, and the furniture smashed.
title: [Krol Ship, Purser's Office]
11112.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This room contains half a dozen various racks for swords, axes, and other weapons, but not a dagger remains.  All the racks have been splintered, their locks destroyed, and the contents pilfered.
title: [Krol Ship, Armory]
11113.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This section of the deck lies beneath the ship's foremast, the peak of which is some fifty feet above your head.  A flight of stairs leads up from here to the forecastle, while the gangplank and the cargo hatch lie aft of here along the deck.  Underneath the forecastle you spot a door leading inside.
title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Forward]
11114.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The deck here is elevated from the main deck to provide a tactical advantage to the sailors during boardings.  From here most of the river can be viewed, as well as most of the cove to the south.
title: [Krol Ship, Forecastle]
11115.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tenuously you cling to the large spar here which extends out from the bow of the ship.  Below you the water from a small river flows past the anchor chain and into the cove with a constant gurgle.  It looks as though the only way to go is back down the bowsprit, but you may be able to climb down the anchor chain with care.
title: [Krol Ship, Bowsprit]
11116.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are holding on to the wet anchor chain with the greatest of care, fully aware of the water swirling under the ship, below you.  Although the bowsprit is not high above you, trying to climb up to it would be suicide.  A few feet above you, the chain disappears into the ship's hull through the hawse hole.  You may be able to squeeze through it.
title: [Krol Ship, Anchor Chain]
11117.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This large room seems to serve many purposes but from the strong smell of sweat you can guess that it's most commonly used as the crew quarters.  A wooden ladder extends down into the hold from here.
title: [Krol Ship, Forecastle]
11118.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This is the forward section of the hold, the bulkheads curving inward toward the bow.  The hold is damp and dimly lit, as the only light seems to be coming from the grate high overhead aft of here.  A wooden ladder extends up into the forecastle and down into the darkness of the bilge.
title: [Krol Ship, Hold Forward]
11119.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A slight amount of light coming down from the companionway allows you to detect the steep stairs, but otherwise this part of the ship is totally dark.  Sounds of lapping water and a rank smell disturb your other senses.
title: [Krol Ship, Bilge Aft]
11120.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The foul stench of rotting flesh fills your nose as you strain to see in the blackness of the bilge.  There is barely enough room to stand beneath the beams which form the floor of the hold above.  Brackish water swirls about, ankle deep.
title: [Krol Ship, Bilge Forward]
11121.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ship towers over the water, casting its shadow over the rocks as well as the shore.  The anchor chain trails down the side of the ship, and disappears into the depths of the river.
title: [Under the Ship's Shadow]
11122.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Made of shining bronze and adorned with glistening obsidian, two doors rise high and wide above the fine tiled floors, now faded and covered with dust.  A shriveled corpse sits with its back against the wall, its leather armor brittle and cracked and a rusty shortsword still encased in its bony grip.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, out
title: [Entrance Hall]
11359.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: It must have been quick, you think, looking at the two skeletons before you, circled in dark stains.  Your gaze follows the stains across the room as they lead to a sturdy table, upon which rests the petrified remains of a meal.
title: [Guard Room]
11360.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A couch and three chairs, sparingly upholstered, look uncomfortable, even when you imagine them new.  Perhaps comfort was never their intent.  The tapestries covering the walls, however, are another matter.  You sense they were once plush and richly woven, but many unkind years have exacted a heavy toll on them and they are now too faded and moth-eaten to even discern what they once depicted.
title: [Waiting Room]
11361.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Six columns of stone rise to the ceiling of this large audience chamber.  As your eye follows the columns you see a raised dais, upon which rest four carved fel wood thrones.  Each of these cushioned thrones is painted a different color: blue, white, red, and green.  Two tapestries are hung in this room, one depicting the founding of Elanith, the other bearing the seal of the Council of Twelve.  A skeleton lies at the base of the dais, obviously killed by a mighty blow to the chest.
title: [Council Audience Chamber]
11362.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The smooth granite walls of this hallway were probably very beautiful when polished daily, but now appear to be sadly neglected.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11363.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Many layers of dust coat the floor of the hallway here, dampening the sounds of your footfalls.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11364.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shelves line this storeroom from the floor to the ceiling.  Many of them appear to be empty and a thick layer of dust covers the remaining piles of jars and rotting crates.
title: [Storeroom]
11365.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The forces of time seem to have left the smooth granite of this hallway untouched as no cracks show in the walls.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11366.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are greeted by the scenes of a battle fought long ago as you enter the small guard post.  An overturned table lies in the middle of the room and the shattered pieces of several chairs lie strewn about.  Several dried, dark brown stains cover the floor.  Could they be the dried blood of the former guardians?
title: [Guard Post]
11367.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large, ironbound door interrupts the simplistic beauty of the smooth granite wall here.  Next to the door is a small pile of decaying rags and sticks which appears to once have been used as torches.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11368.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Scribes once worked furiously at these four desks, detailing all of the actions taken by the Council and its servants.  The shelves are crammed from floor to ceiling with papers and scrolls:  census records, imports, exports, treaties, council meetings, and military actions.
title: [Hall of Records]
11369.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The dust of many years covers the floor of the hallway and a stale smell assaults the senses.  The walls here glow with a pulsating light which speeds through the spectrum making you dizzy.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11370.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The silence of the long-deserted citadel is oppressive here as no sounds seem to reach you from the outside.  A door of shining black enamel is set into one wall of the hallway.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11371.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: As you enter the room a soft light emanates from above but has no apparent source.  A large oval table of black enamel dominates the room.  Placed around the table are twelve black-enameled chairs, each bearing the gilt symbol of one of the Twelve Magi of Elanith.
title: [Council Conference Room]
11372.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Once the private library of the magi, this room appears to have been ransacked in earlier times.  Three desks, three chairs, and a large sculpture of a knight slaying a small drake remain.  The understated elegance of the chamber is hinted at by the exquisitely carved bookshelves, still lined with the remains of books, tomes, scrolls and letters.
title: [Council Library]
11373.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One wall of this room holds two large murals, one of the city defenses, and one of the shores of Maelstrom Bay, dotted with forts and settlements.  A large sand table holds lead figurines in warlike poses, and six small wooden ships.  The far wall is dominated by a huge stone fireplace.  A third wall has a silver inlay of the seal of the Council of Mages.
title: [Council War Room]
11374.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cool draft drifts down a staircase.  Carved from the very granite of the walls, it appears to lead up to a second floor.  A rusty iron handrail held in place by two loose rivets provides the only support on the stairway.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11375.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cool draft blows down the spiral stone staircase in this corner of the hallway, sending the dust on the floor into intricate spirals in the air.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11376.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hallway is adorned with oak paneling which would look beautiful if polished.  However, it doesn't appear as if anyone has been by in many decades to perform that function.  It's a wonder that the wood has survived at all, with the obvious lack of care.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11377.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sawdust on the floor makes your footing uncertain here.  Stone weights, target dummies and a hacking post are positioned about the room.  On the far wall is a well-used knife target.  Against one wall stands a rack of wooden practice weapons.  Several charts are plastered to the walls showing wrestling holds and areas of the body which will cripple or critically wound a foe.
title: [Exercise Room]
11378.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large four poster bed with decaying linen hangings dominates the room.  Sitting on a simple nightstand next to the bed is a yellowed and cracked porcelain pitcher.  A simple wooden trunk rests at the foot of the bed.
title: [Bedroom]
11379.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bare stone shows through gaps where the paneling has been ripped from the walls.  Some malevolent force or creature appears to have caused this damage, rather than time itself.  Claw and weapon marks score the granite walls where the paneling was destroyed.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11380.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The oak paneling of the hallway has decayed into sawdust in several areas revealing the grey stone of the walls beneath.  As you walk down this hallway, your feet make a soft shuffling noise in the sawdust that has fallen to the floor.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11381.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This room has a purposeful look about it, as if important work was once performed here.  A desk occupies the center of the room, positioned to face a couch and within easy reach of a bookcase.  Resting on the shelves of the bookcase are several sculptures and figurines of wood and metal, all bearing a military theme.
title: [Living Room]
11382.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dust blows into the hallway from the west in delicate spirals that rise as high as the ceiling before drifting to the floor.  An empty bookshelf sits against the wall next to a circular window in the east wall.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11383.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Placed on the west wall is a massive painting opposite a narrow stone door seamlessly set into the wall.  Torch sconces line the hallway leading to the north and south above wood paneling and a faded dark blue carpet laid down along the expanse of the corridor.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11384.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dulled by age and dust, a large wood-paneled door stands at the end of the corner of the hallway.  From beneath the door flows warm drafts that stir the dust into the air, where it hangs in transparent light brown clouds before slowly dropping to the floor.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11385.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spiraling upward, the black stone staircase is cut from the very stone of the wall of the Citadel.  Lining the hallway to the west is wood paneling covered in a thin layer of dust, occasionally gutted by the presence of dry rot and scarred by claw marks.
title: [Citadel, Hallway]
11386.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The floor in the corner of the battlement drops away into a spiraling stone staircase that vanishes below.  On either side of the staircase, the crenellated walls of the battlement run to the west and to the east, periodically marked by rusting flagpoles absent any streaming banners.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11387.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bolted firmly to a battlement is a small ballista crafted entirely of metal pointed downward and overlooking the western expanse surrounding the Citadel.  Set underneath the ballista is a rack filled with narrow metal arrows permanently fused together by a layer of thick red and brown rust.  The rust has flaked away, coating the surrounding ground, which is peppered with footprints from recent passersby.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11388.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A single rusting gauntlet lies against a battlement, its fingers curled around a simple black iron chain attached to the stone floor for no apparent purpose.  The end of the chain ends abruptly in a broken metal link.  A series of hills and a deep vale are visible to the east surrounded by wilderness.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11389.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This section of the battlements is clear of rusting metal with the exception of an unadorned flagpole, which is covered in occasional patches of browns and reds.  Nothing shattered nor broken is visible to speak of the violent fall of the fortress, with this section affected only by the warm breezes buffeting the uppermost section of the Citadel.  Twinkling burning violets line the pathway below, their etheral light halting abruptly along the rim of the ravine.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11390.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An iron bucket filled with rain-packed sand and rusting metal arrowheads sits in the corner of the battlement.  From a flagpole bolted to the wall of the battlement, a blue and buff banner ripples in the warm breezes drifting over the top of the wall, snapping with every strong burst of wind.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11391.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reaching out across the stone floor of the battlements is a bleached bony hand belonging to an armored skeleton.  The skeleton lies propped against the wall, a large boulder resting on his lower half.  The passage of time has removed the skull from the body, depositing it elsewhere out of sight, leaving the unknown Citadel defender to an eternity of indignity.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11392.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Driven into the mortar between the blocks of the battlement is a rusting dagger framed by the fields of burning violets below, which flank the approach to the Citadel and the drawbridge.  Lying askew on the ground next to the wall is a pitted and rusted helmet with a panache of faded feathers.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11393.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wind whistles through a gap in the battlement in a space created by the absence of a stone block.  The wail climbs and lowers in an intensity as the strength of the breeze rises and diminishes, offering a haunting song rich with the aroma of the burning violets carried upon the wind.  Below, the ravine beckons along the base of the Citadel, dark and forboding.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11394.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Through the spaces in the crenellated wall, fields of burning violets shimmer and sway, taking on the appearance of a bed of molten lava.  Strong breezes lift up the fragrance of the violets, swirling it about the battlements.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11395.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Perched from the top of a battlement is a single flagpole bereft of flag or banner.  Painted up and down its length are spirals of rust, which coalesces at the base of the pole, staining the metal brackets that attach it to the stone.  Beyond the battlement, lies the western domain of the Citadel in its ruined glory, left as testament to the fall of the mighty fortress.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11396.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sand spills out from a rusted metal bucket knocked over on its side beside a battlement, covering much of the surrounding floor with its gritty substance.  Interspersed in the spillage are numerous metal arrowheads and faded fletchings, absent the wooden shafts that once made them whole.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11397.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: From high overhead come the screams of massive blood eagles.  The great birds circle slowly above the Citadel, casting their massive shadows down across the battlement as they pass between the moonlit sky and the ground.  The night is periodically interrupted as one of the winged beasts appears from over the horizon, screams in pleasure, and releases an unfortunate victim from a great height to plummet to the earth below.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11398.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rattling in the warm breezes, the flagpole fights against the rusted brackets securing it to the battlement.  Below and slightly to the north are the gardens of the Citadel, represented by a patchwork of colors focused upon a pool of blue.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11399.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spectral lights randomly flare in and out of existence across the vista viewable from the top of the battlement as the present inhabitants of the Citadel make their presence known.  Bolted to the stone surface of the battlement is a rusted stand, designed to support some unknown device.  Below the stand is an equally rusted rack with a single tarnished metal arrow still awaiting use.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11400.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Warm winds sweep over the battlement overlooking the northern half of the Citadel complex, offering a bird's eye view to the disrepair and destruction visited upon the fortress over the centuries.  A steel bucket sits by the wall, filled with rusted metal arrow heads interspersed with faded fletchings.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11401.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Marking the northern boundary of the complex are the rooflines of the armory and the garrison to the north and the infirmary to the northwest.  Beyond the buildings and the surrounding walls of the Citadel is empty wilderness, stretching off toward the horizon, interrupted only by the occasional tall tree or open meadow.
title: [Citadel, Battlement]
11402.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Little more than a shelf extending from the side of the Citadel, the balcony is hidden by a low wall with several arrow slits.  Metal quivers attached to the wall await arrows, while a glimpse through the arrow slits reveal the land to the east of the Citadel.  Small flares of fire come and go on the pathway below, while further away, a series of hills give way to a wide vale.
title: [Citadel, Balcony]
17701.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Long and wide, the room is divided by many worktables and bookshelves.  Hot air stirs about the area, rustling papers and the canvas coverings over small and large cages.  Absent is dust with much of the room appearing as if it was only recently abandoned.
title: [Citadel, Workshop]
17702.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Black scorch marks create a sporadic circle that fills the open floor space of west side of the workshop.  Within the circle, the floor is covered in claw marks and scratches, which end abruptly at the black marks, leaving the remainder of the stone flooring in pristine condition.

title: [Troll Lair, Entrance Hall]
11415.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This huge chamber smells of rotted meat. There are several uncured pelts here, each covering a mat of dried leaves.  The pelts are moth-eaten, slightly bald and generally torn up.  In the center is a well used firepit.  There are large animal bones and skulls lying about.

11416.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hall is strewn with droppings, litter, and animal parts, making footing difficult at best.  Among the debris can be seen various bits of leather and metal that appear to have once been armor.  A fouler stench wafts in from the northeast.

title: [Troll Lair, Hall]
11417.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A single skin-covered pallet stands by the wall of the small chamber, which is apparently home to a single troll.  The floor is covered in debris, old bones, and half-eaten game, and a small cask stands in one corner.

description: This tiny room holds a stash of food, sacks and tools for digging.

description: This room is small, cramped and dank.  There are three skins, covering matted leaves, which serve as beds.  Moss competes with garbage for floor space.  The walls are caked with grime and decaying meat.  The corners are crowded with bones and rancid flesh.
title: [Troll Lair, Quarters]

16048.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wide-planked pine floor is worn and scuffed in the middle.  The lower third of the walls are lined with pale green ceramic tiles.  A brass lantern hangs from the ceiling.  The air smells of dust and mold.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
16056.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

16058.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dusty cobwebs cover the ceiling.  The wide-planked pine floor shows little wear.  Mold grows in the grouting of the pale green ceramic tiles.  A brass lantern hangs from the ceiling.  The smell of mold and dust permeates the hallway.
title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
16059.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This spartan room has been half-heartedly ransacked. description: On the north wall is an intricate design depicting a proud warrior in gleaming armor.  He sits astride a heavily armored war-horse, wielding a large menacing blade on a field of battle. description: A long table of polished modwir stands in the center of the room, flanked by benches. description: A cracked bed frame is piled into one corner.  Beside it, the doors on a large wardrobe sag open, revealing several slashed and faded uniforms.

description: The path is so obscured by jungle foliage that following it requires as much guesswork as woodcraft.  Gigantic leaves droop low over the narrow pathway, ferns and tall jungle grasses intrude from both sides.  Long strands of silky gossamer from tiny wind-traveling spiders are strung throughout the foliage, shining brightly in the sunlight.

Water drips from the leaves of the massive trees looming overhead.  Their overhanging branches block out all but a few stray motes of sunlight.  The earthy smell of decomposing leaves competes with the sweet scent of the yellow flowers growing in the jungle canopy overhead.

The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a troll raising a spear in triumph has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.

The trunk of a once-massive dead fel tree is enshrouded by the cable-thick shoots of a strangler fig.  Near the top, the greyish fig tree explodes in a halo of green leaves and auburn seed pods.  A few bucket orchids have attached themselves to the fig shoots, their pale yellow blossoms dangling like diseased organs.

The path underfoot can barely be distinguished from the jungle on either side.  Wide-leafed fronds stretch over the pathway, allowing only a few stray beams of sunlight to filter through.  The resilient underbrush on either side of the path springs back quickly as you pass.

The air, redolent with a cloyingly sweet smell, is still and humid.  The jungle undergrowth closes in on all sides, forming a nearly solid wall of green that ripples unnaturally.  The branches of tall trees loom overhead, trailing lianas over the pathway like the stingers of a jellyfish.

Thick vines cross the path, hindering passage but not preventing it.  Large pitcher-shaped plants grow on one side of the pathway.  Their bluish-grey flowers drip a smelly, viscous fluid onto the leaves.  A stand of tall bamboo trees rattles in the breeze.

The jungle, dark and impenetrable, looms in on all sides.  The path is nothing more than a line of slightly less dense foliage.  A few easily dodged liana runners are strung across the path.  A cloyingly sweet smell wafts through the area.

The thick jungle foliage gives way to a fairly open area dotted with blocks of stone and bits of debris, clearly the remnants of some ancient building.  Part of one wall remains standing, though it leans precariously.  Vines grow in profusion, covering the blocks of stone and creeping up the wall.

The shards of large earthenware vessels, some still containing the husks of old cloves of garlic, are lined against a collapsed, vine-enshrouded wall.  Two small bones dangle from a wooden peg set into a niche in the wall.  The niche is encircled with two wavy lines of some foul smelling, maroon-colored paste.  The jungle foliage encroaches on the ruins.

A semi-circle of stubby riverstone columns are huddled beneath a leafy canopy of vines.  A thick layer of wax, the residue of hundreds of guttered candles, covers the tops of the columns.  The smell of cinnamon and sweet bay leaf hovers in the air.

An open space in the jungle reveals a pair of collapsed stone buildings.  The weed-dotted walkway of carefully laid, flat riverstones is strewn with bits of rubble from the crumbling structures.  One building remains partially intact, two of its walls still standing.  Faint symbols are visible on the lintel above the doorway.

A marble statue of a reclining person, moss-covered and enshrouded by thick lianas, occupies the center of this small clearing.  The head of the marble figure has been replaced with a coconut, painted to express an obscene leer.  The jungle, noisy and oppressive, looms in on all sides.

A massive, vine-wrapped fel tree overhangs the faint pathway.  Skulls hanging from leather cords attached to the upper branches rattle together in the gentle breeze.  The thick undergrowth is spotted with bird droppings.

The high-pitched humming of gnats can be heard throughout the area.

Water drips from the leaves of the massive trees looming overhead.  Their overhanging branches block out all but a few stray beams of moonlight.  The earthy smell of decomposing leaves competes with the sweet scent of the yellow flowers growing in the jungle canopy overhead.

The path underfoot can barely be distinguished from the jungle on either side.  Wide-leafed fronds stretch over the pathway, allowing only a few stray beams of moonlight to filter through.  The resilient underbrush on either side of the path springs back quickly as you pass.

The triple canopy jungle blocks out nearly all the moonlight, leaving the area in a state of near darkness.  Short ferns with palmate leaves edged like daggers grow in profusion at the base of the tall trees.  Flowering vines drape from the lower limbs of the trees.  Fungus grows thick on the vines, giving them a green hairy appearance.

The path is so obscured by jungle foliage that following it requires as much guesswork as woodcraft.  Gigantic leaves droop low over the narrow pathway, ferns and tall jungle grasses intrude from both sides.  Long strands of silky gossamer from tiny wind-traveling spiders are strung throughout the foliage, shining brightly in the moonlight.

Bamboo grows tall and thick, forming a nearly impassable barrier.  Pale rays of moonlight filter through the bamboo leaves.  The fast-growing bamboo has encroached on the pathway, making it nothing more than a narrow track.

description: Moonlight on the winding path between the trees only emphasizes the depth of shadows beneath the canopy of leaves.  There are few landmarks by which to find your way, but the spicy scent of dried oak leaves and the somnolescent murmur of owls make the meandering journey pleasant.

Dappled sunlight on the winding path between the trees only emphasizes the cool green shadows beneath the canopy of leaves.  There are few landmarks by which to find your way, but the spicy scent of dried oak leaves and the constant birdsong make the meandering journey pleasant.
Fallen leaves crunch underfoot as you wander without direction through the woods.  The light slanting through the trees gives the forest a serene, yet somber cast.

The trek through the trackless forest seems to have no end.  A downed oak, its decaying trunk as thick as a small town's streets are wide, sprouts an array of fungi in subtle and beautiful colors.  Despite this proof that for every life the forest claims, it sustains many more, it seems a waste that such a magnificent tree has fallen to rot.

A light breeze stirs the treetops above you, but the air closer to the forest floor is still.  Small red mushrooms, their caps vivid against deep green moss, adorn the bases of the vine-wreathed oaks and modwirs surrounding you.  Fallen leaves obscure any hint of a trail, and no path between the trees seems preferable to another.

Leaves beside the trail appear to have been disturbed recently, and closer examination shows the faint tracks of a predatory cat, perhaps a puma, pressed into the softer mud beneath the fallen foliage.  You see no sign of a struggle, though, and if the cat was hunting it seems likely the prey was lucky this time.

The trees give way to rushes around a small pond, giving you an unobstructed view of the limitless expanse of sky above you.  Water-striders dimple the pond's mirror-bright surface and cling to the slender leaves of irises growing along its mossy banks.

Dappled sunlight on the forest floor and a nearby stand of oak trees look familiar, but the sun has stayed in its proper position in the sky and proves that you aren't yet lost enough to go in circles.  The soporific drone of bees attending to the flowers at the base of towering trees combines pleasantly with birdsong, the mellifluous music of nature making the heat and exertion more tolerable.
The scent of damp earth implies a nearby pond or stream, but the countless trees obscure your view.  Leaves rustle at your approach as small creatures flee your imposition on their territory.

Leaves on the forest floor are hidden among tussocks of grass as the stately old-growth modwirs give way to willows, their lighter greens brilliant in the sunlight.  A nearby outcropping of native rock would be about knee-high on an average human, and judging by the smooth polish of its top, it has seen much use as a seat.

description: The river curves around this small bit of land, the sound of its passing a quiet rush that provides a background of white noise.  Above that sound is the noise of people talking and laughing, and the air is filled with the scent of food and drink.
title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
23959.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A thick damp mist envelopes the space immediately adjacent to the falls, rising from the roaring crash of the Tempest waters as they plummet below.  Little can be seen through the enshrouding mist, which only breaks apart occasionally to reveal a glimpse of the small town situated on the egg-shaped island below in the river.  The roar of the falls is almost deafening, and the rushing of the waters shake the earth underfoot.
title: [Tempest Falls, Above the Falls]
23960.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A deep, constant rumble comes from the direction of the falls, and the swiftly moving waters of the Tempest flow toward the sound.  Tall reeds line the bank of the river, home to the occasional silently poised heron and the random splash of a startled frog or turtle.  Parallel to the river, an old overgrown dirt road leads to the east.
title: [Tempest River, Before the Falls]
23961.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick grass and weeds obscure much of the old river road that winds its way to the east and west along the Tempest.  Insects buzz angrily amid the brush, disturbed by movement through the tranquil perches they've found in the tall assortment of grasses and weeds.  Burrs hang threateningly, distracting from what appears to be something constructed by the hand of man to the east.
title: [Tempest River, River Road]
23962.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Just visible above the overgrowth of the river road are the remains of a small river port, a mixture of skeletal stones and intact structures.  Jutting only a few feet into the river adjacent to the port are the remnants of an old stone dock, now silt-covered and the perching place of dark green moss.  Just beyond the port and commanding a view of the surrounding terrain is a prominent mound.
title: [Tempest River, River Road]
23963.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Nature has done much to reclaim the old river port set beside the Tempest, with vines clinging possessively to masonry and weeds obscuring foundations.  The visible port has the resemblance of a small village built around a narrow rectangular square.  Several obvious warehouses line the area closest to the river, while miscellaneous and harder to discern structures surround the other sides of the square.
title: [Tempest River, Old River Port]
23964.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The resilient architecture of riverstone has, for the most part, survived the decades-long assault of nature with a number of the some old warehouses still standing, albeit covered in vines both old and new.  Broken windows peer out like empty eye sockets, and open doorways linger like black, hungry maws awaiting a meal.
title: [Tempest River, Old Warehouses]
23965.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The square is recognizable only by the buildings which frame it and is otherwise obscured by the thick vegetation slowly returning the land to a more natural state.  In the middle of the ruined square is a monument rendered indistinct by the prevalent overgrowth.
title: [Tempest River, Overgrown Square]
23966.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vines criss-cross the floor, invaders from outside having taken advantage of the lack of properly functioning windows and doors.  Beside a window sits a small maple desk surprisingly clear of the ongoing assault by nature elsewhere in the run-down home.  What other furniture remains is decayed and skeletal, echoes of a once former vibrant home, and as forgotten and abandoned as much of the port.
title: [Tempest River, Rundown House]
23967.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The broken dreams of long dead men, covered and reclaimed by the wild impulses of nature, stand barely discernible from the untouched growth of the land beside the river.  Trees and bushes intermingle with what might have once been statuary, fusing the art of nature with that of mortal hand.  An overgrown pathway, barely wider than a game path, leads away from the ruined port and toward a large bald mound.
title: [Tempest River, Old River Port]
23968.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A circle of brush surrounds the mound top like a monk's tonsure, leaving its crest bare but for a number of weeds and an old rust-covered catapult.  Over the top of the brush, one can spy the Tempest River as it disappears over the falls and the resulting cloud of ever-present cloaking mist.  Even further beyond, the sight of a turtle egg-shaped island and its odd array of businesses and homes can be seen.  Standing tall out of the weeds, the abandoned catapult points toward the town.
title: [Tempest River, Mound]
23969.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls and floor of the basket are woven with reinforcing strips of metal, tinted brown by decades of rust, the flakes of which have created a reddish brown stain underfoot.  Metal hooks are placed across the floor in neat orderly rows, perhaps once connected by rope or leather as a means to separate the basket's contents.  Scrapes in the rust along the walls imply that not all launches from the catapult were executed cleanly.
title: [Flinger Basket]
23970.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Disarray and dust aptly describe the interior of the abandoned house.  What furniture remains lies up-ended and covered in a fine layer of filth, the sole exception being an oak writing table situated near a window that gazes out to the southwest and the rest of the old port.  Vines invade the house, reaching in through broken windows and wide-flung doors, as if the wilds outside are determined to overcome all trace of habitation.
title: [Tempest River, Abandoned House]
23971.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sheets of canvas are strung up on both sides of a wooden gate to provide privacy.  Painted on the canvas are a variety of brightly colored fish.  The sounds of splashing and laughter bubble out from behind the canvas.  A large sign is affixed to the canvas beside the gate.  An old crone is perched on a stool beside the sign.
title: [Herring Toss, Entrance]
23972.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small, rather shabby canvas tent has been erected in the middle of the otherwise tidy green lawn.  The sharp smell of pickle brine surrounds the tent.  An old crone sits on a three-legged stool beside the tent flap.  Beside the stool is a hand-painted sign.
title: [Bobbing for Pickles, Entry]
23973.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dilapidated wooden planks make up this small seedy-looking booth, and a halfhearted attempt to mask the shoddy workmanship with a thin coat of noxious green paint only serves to make the squat structure uglier.  A table bridges the gap between the outside and the proprietor inside, whose voice continually rings out as he hawks his game.  A large banner drooping across the top of the wooden booth displays "The Ol' Switcheroo" in splotchy red letters.
title: [The Ol' Switcheroo]
23974.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Howling winds create a feint whistling effect as they blast through gaps in the walls of the small workshop.  Crowded with a grinder, polisher, and a workbench with a vise, this room is perhaps a third of the building's interior.  Besides the exit, an iron bound door pierces the center of the hut's one interior wall.  For whatever reason, the bases of the workbench, grinder, and polisher have each been inlaid with fragments of coral.
title: [Coral Workshop]
24267.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large, black iron anvil stands in the center of this chamber.  Within easy reach to either side of the anvil are a brick forge and a tempering trough.  Directly above the trough, suspended by a web of delicate mithril chains, hangs a teardrop-cut crystal easily the size of a giantman.  One corner of the room is taken up by a cistern inlaid with fragments of coral, and a leather bucket hangs from a hook on the wall next to it.  Heat from the brick forge fills the chamber.  Some discarded oilskins rest haphazardly in the corner.
title: [Coral Forge]
24268.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The surrounding trees thin somewhat and allow a glimpse of a clearing to the north.  The ground slopes down on either side of the path into an impassable tangle of brush.
title: [A Narrow Path]
24415.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The dense trees give way to a large clearing, its grasses rippling like water in the breeze.  Constellations of wildflowers are bright within the verdant sea, but banners of viridian and gold flying from the central pole of a large pavilion to your north are more vivid still.
title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
24416.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Open on all sides to the mild breeze, this tent is large enough to shelter many.  Zephyrs tease the tassels of numerous cushions scattered on the intricately woven rugs which cover smoothly packed earth.  A lectern carved from a tree stump stands at one end of the pavilion, its surface polished to a mellow sheen and engraved with twining vines.  A path leads west to a garden.
title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion]
24417.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Herbs grow in riotous profusion along the path and the only evidence of design is the orderly grouping of the plants by use.  The cool, clean scents of mint and lavender perfume the air, while dittany and borage grow in the shade of a nearby oak tree.  The murmur of running water comes from somewhere to the west.
title: [Ranger Guild, Garden Path]
24418.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The natural spring has been roughly outfitted as a bath.  Flat stones upon which brilliant green lizards sun themselves ring the pool, the jewel-bright creatures eyeing you expectantly as if waiting for you to follow their example.  Sweetflags and rushes line the banks of the shallow runoff stream, following it west into impenetrable foliage.  The water is clear and the sandy bottom of the pool is a dazzling white in the sunlight.
title: [Ranger Guild, Spring]
24419.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This secluded spot is concealed both from the clearing to the north and the spring to the south by walls of close-growing bushes.  Ferns thrive in the humid shade of overarching oak trees, their tightly curled fiddleheads as smooth as carved jade against the rough dark tree trunks.  Snatches of conversation and laughter drift in on the breeze, but they seem somehow more distant than they could logically be.
title: [Ranger Guild, Glade]
24420.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The path winds up to the lodge, which is built wide and low beneath a copper roof.  Unstained oak walls have been planed to display the natural grain of the wood, and darker modwir frames the entrance.  A single apple tree by the stone steps provides welcome shade.
title: [Ranger Guild, Lodge]
24421.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Plain cotton cushions cover the sanded maoral planks in lieu of chairs.  Wind chimes of wood and beaten brass turn in the breeze and add their gentle harmony to the atonal, yet tranquil music of nature.  To your south, the pavilion rises above the treetops, its banners brilliant against the cloudless sky.
title: [Ranger Guild, Front Porch]
24422.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A discordant harmony of rustling and cawing issues from the low log building that dominates the clearing.  To the southwest, a larger edifice can be glimpsed through the trees, while banners flutter gaily to the south.
title: [Ranger Guild, Mews]
24423.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of widely spaced perches and the faint scent of rotting meat would give name to this low structure's purpose, even if there were not nearly a dozen merlins, kestrels, and larger hawks resting upon the high poles.  A far wall is studded with pegs, each one hung with the finely crafted bits of leather that serve as jess and hood to a hunting bird.  Bars of sunlight slanting through the high narrow windows appear almost solid with dust from the hay-strewn floor.
title: [Ranger Guild, Mews]
24424.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The passage of many feet has worn a shallow trough down the center of the path.  A gabled roof of verdigris-rimed metal rises above the treetops to the east, while to the west the trail widens into a roughly rectangular clearing.
title: [Ranger Guild, Path]
24425.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bales of straw in ranks on the northern edge of the clearing prop up colorful archery targets. An expanse of pale river sand spanning the length of the clearing makes arrows easier to find and keeps grass from overtaking the range.
title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
24426.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Modwir posts and beams are a darker accent to the white oak walls of this open room. title: [Ranger Guild, Foyer]
24427.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The high modwir-beamed ceiling gives the bar an expansive feel and ivy growing through cutouts in the window frames climbs along trellises affixed to the walls. title: [Ranger Guild, Bar]
24428.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A modwir desk is the only indication that this room is used as an office. A thick bow-shaped perch, jesses and a hood hanging from it, stands in one corner of the room.
title: [Ranger Guild, Masters' Office]
24429.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The broad sweep of the carpeted floor is interrupted by a tiered alabaster fountain. title: [Kaldonis's Magic Shoppe]

description: Embedded in the floor are crushed mermaid's-tear sapphires, laid to form the image of a boot with a large buckle within a circle of star-of-Tamzyrr diamonds.  Pushed against the walls are several work tables, which take up a considerable amount of space in the room.  Small pieces of metal and scraps of leather litter the ground surrounding a short glaes-bound barrel, its lid discarded beneath a free-standing tool rack in the center of the room.  Larger than the others, this workshop can accommodate several people.
title: [Sapphire Workshop]
24498.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deliberately arranged across the stone flooring to create a checkerboard pattern are sage green rush mats that are trimmed with a deep ebony border.  Along the back wall, an overburdened desk is practically buried under stacks of papers and ledgers.  Lost in thought, the workshop foreman stands in front of a fresco depicting a landscape of an ancient forest with snow-capped mountains in its distance.
title: [Cobbling Court, Foreman Office]
24499.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Placed in opposite corners of the room, identical flowerpots overflow with remarkable specimens of petunias, from the deepest shade of purple to a pale pink.  Globed lanterns dangle from slim, wrought iron poles embedded into the stone floor.  The soft light from within the lanterns creates a dizzying dance of shadows along the walls.  A lone chair occupied with only a leather-bound tome rests directly beneath one of the lanterns.  Sticking out from between the pages is the feather of a blood eagle.
title: [The Cobbling Court, Registrar]
24500.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  The counter is topped with deep green baize which shows little wear.
title: [Twilight Hall, Locker]
24578.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The fabric walls of this small stall are only loosely tied to its wooden frame, the vibrantly hued material rustling with even the slightest breeze.  A short, three-legged table sits in the middle of this area, with a small tin bucket atop it, and a tall willow flower basket sits directly beside it.
title: [Blooms, Strings, and Things]
24579.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This section of the stall is completely enclosed in brightly hued fabric save the passage that leads to the front of the shop.  Along the back wall, a narrow counter occupies the space between two wooden supports, and a squat clear glass jar and a smooth clear glass dish share the display area.
title: [Blooms, Strings, and Things]
24580.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The open expanse of the tent's interior is complemented by the airy quality of its layered ivory silk construction and peaked ceiling.  Gauzy swathes of golden mesh are scalloped along the upper edge of the walls, held in place at each peak by a spray of milky white lilies.  A lengthy buffet table dominates the left side of the tent, while the remaining space is occupied by half a dozen round tables set with chairs in front of a raised dais.  A myriad of winterberry ale barrels perched on oaken stands rest at the dais' edge.
title: [Ivory Tent, Interior]
24582.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wagon's interior walls bear a high gloss resultant of meticulous polishing and attentive care.  Luminous brass lanterns hang from the heavy struts overhead, shedding a warm amber light perfumed with vanilla in pools across the area.  Opposite the entry, a tall chest sits, and one of its drawers has been left open, with a small parchment note hanging from its golden pull.  Against a side wall is a rack that stands across from a full-length brass-framed mirror, and between the two is a door leading out.
title: [The Lapidary]
24583.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The precarious dirt path that leads down from the bank strays close to the water's edge before widening into a small patch of marshy earth framed on three sides by riverstones.  Within the confines of this rudimentary "garden" are several glossy-leafed bushes laden with clusters of blue-black winterberries, as if someone were merely trying to cultivate the look of a purposeful planting with the rocky border.  A fitfully guttering lantern hangs from the nearby post, shedding minimal illumination.
title: [River's Rest, Winterberry Patch]
24584.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cut glass shades guard the tiny flames of the candles atop the lanterns along the walls, and this area of the wagon is filled with a warm amber light.  Off against the far wall sits a wardrobe filled to brimming with gowns, and to the side of it is a set of wrought iron hooks on the wall.  Opposite the wardrobe is a small set of shallow risers, which display a variety of footwear, and nearby is a circular table draped in velvet.
title: [Behind The Masque, Ladies]
24585.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The candles within the lanterns in this section of the wagon give off the faint aroma of cedar, and it mingles with the scent of leather in the air originating from the wares on display.  Against the side wall, a stately wardrobe stands with its doors propped open, and off to the left is a square pedestal table.  A wrought iron rack stands across the way on the opposite side of a carpeted runner that divides the space.
title: [Behind The Masque, Gentlemen]
24586.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shelves line the walls of this small area of the wagon, laden with jars of brightly gleaming gemstones, vases of colorful feathers, and spools of satin ribbons in a variety of hues.  Overhead hangs several glass-shaded lanterns, filling the room with a warm, amber light, while piles of silken pillows ring the edge of the space, all centered around a single, tufted violet cushion.  Near the cushion sits a tiered sewing box and several trays of odd and intriguing adornments.
title: [Behind The Masque, Workroom]
24587.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pair of lanterns with cut crystal shades hang directly over a delicately carved jewelry stand, the pristine light dancing over every reflective surface under its touch.  Further into the area, a doorless golden oak armoire stands off to the side - a hulking piece of furniture itself, it is dwarfed by the high ceilings of wagon.  Near the armoire, sits a tiered shoe rack, and just a few steps away, a drawn ivory marbrinus curtain leads into another section of the shop.
title: [The Lapidary]
24588.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The oversized scale of the wagon persists even in this section of the wagon, clearly the front most compartment set just beneath the driver's bench.  Scalloped swags of beaded silk fringe decorate the step-cut ceiling at the far end, while a profusion of brass lanterns hang overhead to provide copious amounts of light.  Along the outer edge of the space, several small sofas and chairs have been placed, while an oval table occupies the heart of the area.
title: [The Lapidary, Workshop]
24589.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cast-off easy chairs dot the amphitheater's green room, providing comfortable seating for actors waiting to go onstage.  In the center are an oval table and several ladder-backed chairs, and along one wall sits a paint-spattered dressing stand next to several stacks of wooden folding chairs.  Last minute appearance checks are facilitated by a full-length mirror mounted beside the door.  A scent of greasepaint and dust lingers lightly throughout the room.
title: [Bard Guild, Green Room]
25597.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The confined backstage area for the Jastev Amphitheater is fitted with the usual jungle-like tangle of ropes, pulleys and flats.  It offers access to the green room and a dressing room, as well as passage back to the Guild Hall via a covered walkway.  The ceiling is high overhead, cloaked with catwalks, scrims and drops, and other miscellany.  A collection of heavy ropes is controlled with a wooden frame mounted on the front wall, allowing the stage curtains to be easily opened and closed.
title: [Bard Guild, Backstage]
25598.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The arched walkway spanning the distance between the Bard Guild and the Jastev Amphitheater is shielded by heavily carved wooden screens along its entire length.  The workmanship exhibited on the screens is masterful, depicting a series of scenes from well-known plays and musical performances.  Through the cavities, the gentle touch of a breeze enters, keeping the elevated walkway a comfortable promenade.
title: [Bard Guild, Covered Walkway]
25599.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The dressing room is barely large enough to house a few furnishings.  A small dresser fitted with a mirror occupies one corner, opposite a teak clothing rack.  A small trunk and a chair complete the ensemble.
title: [Bard Guild, Dressing Room]
25600.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The antechamber of the River's Rest Bard Guild is actually a closed porch.  It is constructed from heavily carved wooden screens on three sides.  The distinctively banded exterior of the three-story building provides the fourth wall, with alternating stripes of ochre and ivory stone providing a marked contrast to the near black of the wooden screens.  Set within a carved sill is an imposing door, its surface decorated with carving so fine and intricate, it would take hours to discover all its detail.
title: [Bard Guild, Antechamber]
25601.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cholen's Pub is a comfortable chamber of dark, polished teak walls and ceiling fans turning in lazy circles overhead.  A couple of tables are placed toward the back of the room, shielded with carved wooden screens for privacy.  However, most of the furnishings are small wooden tables set conveniently between comfortable-looking armchairs.  A pile of pillows is also provided for more relaxed seating.
